mcq_fix.s: Which of the following pairs of exchanges/institutions and their 'first' status is/are correctly matched? A. India INX — first international exchange B. NSDL — first depository C. BSE — Asia's oldest exchange
mcq_fix.why: stem asked to 'arrange' but options test correctness of pairs

mcq_drop.why: oddly built: all options are 'Pherwani' + body type; duplicates NSE origin item
ambiguous A/R: R (definition of primary market) does not explain why SEBI regulates it

pyq_bad.why: garbled: stem carries another item's explanation

patterns: APPSC asks index identity directly: free-float index of top 30 BSE companies = SENSEX; Moody's is not a share index.
Classic one-liners: SENSEX = 30 companies, GREENEX = 25, rise in SENSEX = rise in the group not all shares, Dalal Street = Mumbai.
Market jargon (bull, bear, stag, blue chip, beta) and debenture holders = creditors recur in UPSC/UPPSC.
NSE facts (Mumbai HQ, promoters, highest turnover) and SEBI's regulatory role are common.
App adds 2025-26 IPO/STT/F&O data and several A/R items with weak causal links; PYQs are plain single-fact.
